verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report that Ollama has shipped ROCm containers since 0.1.27, which suggests the runtime itself is distributed in container form. No first-party documentation in the pack confirms how to run it containerized or supports reproducible deployment. Missing for 10: first-party container/Docker documentation, an official image reference, coverage beyond ROCm (CPU/NVIDIA), and guidance on reproducible deployment (version pinning, volumes, configuration).

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime inside a container for reproducible deployment

citations.quote: They have shipped ROCm containers since 0.1.27.
